name: Chaos Rewind
source:
When Erik, a 45-year-old man who feels he wasted his life, helps a wounded alien bounty hunter hiding a stolen artifact, the artifact rewinds the entire Earth by 24 years. Erik wakes up at 21 with all his memories intact, determined to redo his life: college, his band, and the card game he loves, while a galactic federation hunts for the girl now hiding in his house.

An adult visual novel with free-roam exploration, dates with minigames, a collectible card duel system and stealth missions, where the heroines remember your key choices.
